title: deparia liangshanensis var. sericea
intro: Deparia liangshanensis var. sericea, commonly known as the Liangshan Deparia fern, is a species of fern in the genus Deparia. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions. This plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential health benefits, including reducing fever, improving digestion, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Deparia liangshanensis var. sericea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
